_doc: Subresource-integrity pins for the third-party files the T0 map pages load (WP-T0-13). Each hash was computed from bytes fetched on 2026-09-30 with curl (no cookies, no auth) and re-fetched three more times (identity, gzip, with an Origin header, different CloudFront edges) with identical bytes. The generator (gen_pg_maps.mjs) copies these into tools/t0/patches/PG-maps.json; pages-maps.spec.mjs T0-PG-SRI re-fetches the live files when run with --online and compares. If Mapbox ever changes the bytes behind the v3.24.1 URL the map pages fail closed (script blocked) -- drop the integrity attributes (patch ids maps:*:css / maps:*:js) or update this file.

peerjs.min.js.cross_check_source: https://data.jsdelivr.com/v1/packages/npm/peerjs@1.5.4?structure=flat (file hash of /dist/peerjs.min.js equals the sha256 computed locally)
peerjs.min.js.cache: public, max-age=31536000, s-maxage=31536000, immutable (npm version, immutable on jsDelivr)
